summary: Extensions make trust decisions executable, compositional, and continuously tested.

items.text: Compile the map into short-lived capability tokens containing model identity, task ID, allowed actions and resources, data ceiling, budget, expiry, and required approval.
Add composition tests that search for harmful multi-step paths through individually permitted tools, including indirect prompt-injection and confused-deputy scenarios.
Link each authority grant to a task-capability evidence record, while keeping the policy decision independent: being capable never automatically confers permission.
Use incident-sensitive decay: narrow or suspend grants automatically when model, prompt, tool, or environment versions change or when review outcomes cross a risk threshold.
